name: Cayenne Pepper
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical spice quantities. May stimulate digestion and help with motility in some individuals.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts as cayenne can be very hot
Mix into oil-based dishes to distribute heat evenly
Store in airtight container away from light to maintain potency
Can be added during cooking or sprinkled on finished dishes
alternatives: Black pepper for warmth without capsaicin
nutritionalHighlights: High in capsaicin with anti-inflammatory properties
Rich in vitamin A and antioxidants
